finding_addressed: F1 (major) — add-forms accepted fractional values for backend int/int64 fields
summary: Fix is correct and complete. isIntegerValue is applied to exactly the 6 server-side int/int64 fields, deliberately skipped on the 3 float64 fields, step="1" added to the matching 6 inputs, existing >0/>=0/range checks are untouched and still run before the new integer check, and the new/updated tests (41/41) pass.

checks.description: isIntegerValue applied to exactly base_minutes, quick_price, additional_minutes, additional_material_per_unit, min_qty, max_qty; not applied to complexity_coeff, quick_percent, percent
checks.evidence: server/internal/service/costing.go confirms field types: BaseMinutes int (L45), ComplexityCoeff float64 (L46), QuickPrice int64 (L47); AdditionalMinutes int (L51), AdditionalMaterialPerUnit int64 (L52), QuickPercent float64 (L53); MinQty int (L23), MaxQty int (L24), Percent float64 (L25). client/src/pages/Panel.jsx lines 281-341 (validateGarmentFields, validateOperationFields, validateDiscountFields) apply the `else if (!isIntegerValue(...))` branch to exactly the 6 int/int64 fields and add explicit 'намеренно без проверки' comments on the 3 float64 fields (lines 286-287, 311, 335) explaining why they're excluded.

checks.description: isIntegerValue rejects fractional input (e.g. 10.5) and accepts valid integers; error messages are clear
checks.evidence: isIntegerValue (Panel.jsx:260) = Number.isInteger(toFiniteNumber(value)). toFiniteNumber coerces numeric strings and numbers, returns NaN for blank/non-numeric (so Number.isInteger(NaN)=false, no false negative). Error strings are field-specific and in Russian consistent with the rest of the file, e.g. 'База/мин должна быть целым числом', '«От» должно быть целым числом'. Verified via `npx vitest run src/pages/Panel.validation.test.js`: 41/41 tests pass, including new cases for 10.5, '10.5' (string), 0.5, 259.999 rejected and 1/valid integers accepted, plus explicit tests that complexity_coeff/quick_percent/percent still accept fractional values.

checks.description: step="1" added to the 6 corresponding SettingsNumberInput elements in the 3 add-forms
checks.evidence: Confirmed present at Panel.jsx:509 (quick_price), 512 (base_minutes), 627 (additional_minutes), 630 (additional_material_per_unit), 1848 (min_qty), 1851 (max_qty). SettingsNumberInput (Panel.jsx:397) spreads props onto a native <input type="number">, so step is passed through correctly. Non-integer siblings (complexity_coeff, quick_percent, percent) correctly retain step="0.01" and were not touched.

checks.description: Existing >0 / >=0 / range checks still run correctly alongside the new integer check
checks.evidence: New checks are appended as `else if` branches after the existing isPositiveNumber/isNonNegativeNumber guards (Panel.jsx:281-296, 299-316, 318-341), so they only run once the value is already confirmed a finite positive/non-negative number — no change to when the original checks fire or what they reject. In validateDiscountFields the integer check for max_qty is deliberately ordered before the min_qty range comparison (comment at lines 325-327 explains why: a fractional max_qty greater than min_qty must not slip past the range check unflagged). Full test suite (41/41) including pre-existing range/positivity tests passes unmodified.

Helper is placed directly after isNonNegativeNumber (Panel.jsx:242-245) and before isBlankName (Panel.jsx:263), i.e. grouped with the other field-level predicate helpers (toFiniteNumber, isPositiveNumber, isNonNegativeNumber) in the same declarative one-line-body style. Doc comment follows the file's established convention of citing exact costing.go line numbers and explaining the 'why' (late JSON-unmarshal 400 on the whole settings POST) rather than restating the 'what'. Per-field 'намеренно без проверки' comments on the 3 float64 fields make the omission look intentional rather than an oversight for a future reader.

informational_notes.description: The existing inline row-editors for already-saved garments/operations/discounts (Panel.jsx lines ~1350, 1419, 1445, 1448, 1896, 1899 — handleGarmentChange/handleOperationSettingChange/handleDiscountChange) still lack both step="1" and any integer validation for the same 6 fields, so a fractional edit there could still trigger the same late 400 on save.
informational_notes.severity: informational, not a finding against this fix
informational_notes.rationale: Out of scope: F1 and this fix commit (f8216ca) were explicitly scoped to the 3 add-forms per the audit report (code-audit-report.md line 48, 'Add-forms accept fractional values...'), and the row-editor path is a materially different, pre-existing code path not touched by this change. Flagging for awareness only in case a future task wants to extend the same protection to row-editors; not a defect in the change under review.
